changes.summary: assertSameOrigin now compares complete origins and rejects malformed Origin values and same-host protocol/port mismatches.
Added regression coverage for configured origin, protocol/port mismatch, malformed origin and cross-site origin.
Added skip link and focusable main content anchor.
Added an accessible label to the primary navigation.
Restored scripts and dependencies inferred from the actual source tree.
Generated reproducible dependency lockfile with pnpm.
Restored strict Next.js TypeScript configuration and @ path alias.
Restored Tailwind CSS v4 PostCSS integration.
Restored test alias and test discovery configuration.
Documented the intentional .mjs test import exception and typed the callback parameter.
